study type: Secondary analysis of a multicenter cohort study
finding: Pregnant individuals with inadequate health literacy had a higher risk of caesarean delivery, major perineal laceration, and their neonates were more likely to have adverse outcomes like small-for-gestational-age status, low birth weight, and low 5-minute Apgar scores.
mod_finding: Inadequate maternal health literacy was associated with an increased risk of caesarean delivery (adjusted risk ratio [aRR], 1.11; 95% CI, 1.01-1.23) and major perineal laceration (aRR, 1.44; 95% CI, 1.03-2.01).
